chapter_seo_title: A Record of a Mortal’s Journey to Immortality Ch.418 – Han Li’s Gold Thunder Bamboo
chapter_meta_description: Han Li acquires Divine Thunder Bamboo from the Sublime Sound Sect, then uses the Heaven Vial to mature it into legendary Gold Thunder Bamboo. A rare moment of triumph in the Mortal Stream.
og_title: Han Li Turns a Chicken Rib Into a Legendary Treasure
og_description: After acquiring the seemingly useless Divine Thunder Bamboo, Han Li cultivates it into the fabled Gold Thunder Bamboo—his biggest bargain yet.
twitter_title: Han Li’s Ultimate Bargain: Gold Thunder Bamboo
twitter_description: The Sublime Sound Sect thought they got the better of Han Li. They had no idea he could turn their White Thunder Bamboo into a ten-thousand-year Gold Thunder Bamboo.

lore_anchors.definition: One of the three legendary divine bamboos of the cultivation world; its grade is determined by age, with the rarest ten-thousand-year variant called Gold Thunder Bamboo that releases pale-gold lightning capable of countering evil arts.
A lower-grade Divine Thunder Bamboo under five thousand years old, releasing only ordinary white lightning; considered a "chicken rib" by most cultivators due to limited utility.
The ten-thousand-year pinnacle of Divine Thunder Bamboo, producing pale-gold Demon-Repelling Lightning; its appearance in history sparked decades of bloodshed in the Starfall Sea.
The special property of Gold Thunder Bamboo's lightning, which has a natural克制 effect on demonic arts and evil techniques, making it highly prized for refining anti-evil treasures.
A classical Chinese idiom (鸡肋) describing something that is tasteless to eat yet a pity to discard; in the cultivation world, it refers to assets that have high reputation but low practical value.
The vast ocean region where the current arc takes place, known for its abundant resources and chaotic history; the setting of the Star Plucking Assembly and Heaven Star City.
